convert_euler_to_rotation_matrix: convert euler angles to a 3x3 rotation matrix using euler2mat
convert_euler_to_quaternion: convert euler angles to a quaternion using euler2quat
convert_matrix_to_euler: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix back to euler angles using mat2euler

multiply_quaternions: multiply two quaternions together using quat_mul and quat_conjugate
